title: 第17章 卧虎藏龙的浩城第18章 月色下的杀机
slug: 和女帝双修后我出剑即无敌
lines: 还有他那茶叶，居然能够产生一丝真气。
从以上几点来看，那个老家伙绝不简单。
不过他对自己并没有敌意，既然如此那就装糊涂了。
如果他要敢对郑族不利，对郑家不利，自己就是死也要崩断他满口的牙。
郑元又去了一个店铺，买了驭兽袋，然后向老板咨询一下怎么养兽宠。
当然还间接问了一下小白的情况，只不过那老板也一头雾水中。
蛇类要晋级基本都是在冬天才会发生，如今是夏天，太反常了。
不过郑元可没把小白拿出来让那老板鉴定。
俗话说得，害人之心不可有，防人之心不可无。
自己的实力还是太弱，一个药材店老板都高不可测。
浩城恐怕是卧虎藏龙，自己还是少惹麻烦的好。
反正就那条小蛇连自己都打不过，指望它还不如指望自己赶紧提升修为。
“哥，我的玉凤兔呢？”
郑萱看到回家的哥哥郑元一脸兴奋不已地跑了过来，更是一把抱住了郑元的胳膊问道。
糟糕了！
郑元面对小妹也傻眼了，在山上就顾得和楚琳谈情说爱了，还真把帮妹妹抓只兔子的事给忘了。
“坏蛋哥哥，人家生气了，不理你了。”
郑萱撅着嘴，生着气，哥哥一点不守诺言。
“咦？冰糖葫芦，还是五色冰糖葫芦。”
下一刻郑萱不由眼睛一亮，哥哥手里拿着一支自己最爱吃的五色冰糖葫芦。
“谢谢你，哥。”
啪！
郑萱在郑元脸上啪的亲了一口，变得一脸笑意盈盈。
原来郑元回来时想到要给妹妹买点吃的。
“你这丫头，也太没正形了，都多大了，以后还怎么嫁人啊？”
郑母看到女儿的样子不禁一脸怜爱的怪责着。
关键萱儿也老大不小了，一个姑娘家怎么能主动亲别的男人。
“知道了娘。”
郑萱又一把搂住了娘亲的胳膊撒娇着。
嘴里还喃喃自语着，小时候自己不是经常偷偷和哥哥睡在一起嘛，自己才不嫁人呢，要嫁就嫁给哥哥。
“别胡闹了萱妹，娘，这是我给爹和你，小妹买的衣服。”
郑元也知道郑萱不是自己的亲妹妹，不过早就当成了亲妹妹。
郑母一脸高兴，元儿终于长大了，以前只知道修炼，现在会关心人了。
“对了，我爹呢？”
就在郑元话音还未落地郑父从外面走了进来。
“族长找我们商量一下三日后大比的事，这次李家的长子和赵家的二公子可都是强敌，听说两家为他们重金购买了武功秘籍，而且还买了增元丹，他们如今都是开脉三层修为，元儿你要小心了。”
虽然就是一座下品灵石矿，但可是关系到修炼资源。
所以其他两大家族也是不遗余力，郑元父亲也是一脸沉寂，龙争虎斗，必有伤亡。
尤其是赵李两家已经联手了，并且郑家盟友王家也叛变投向了这两家。
content_en:
And his tea leaves can actually produce a trace of true energy.
Judging from the above points, the old guy is anything but simple.
But he was not hostile to himself, so he just pretended to be confused.
If he dared to do harm to the Zheng clan and the Zheng family, he would have all his teeth broken even if he died.
Zheng Yuan went to another store, bought a beast-taming bag, and then asked the boss how to raise pet animals.
Of course, he indirectly asked about Xiaobai's situation, but the boss was also confused.
The promotion of snakes basically only happens in winter. It is summer now, which is too abnormal.
But Zheng Yuan didn't take Xiaobai out for the boss to identify.
As the saying goes, you must not have the intention to harm others, and you must not have the intention to guard against others.
My own strength is still too weak, even a medicine shop owner is unfathomable.
Haocheng is probably a crouching tiger, hidden dragon, so it would be better for him to avoid getting into trouble.
Anyway, that little snake can't even defeat him, so if he expects it, he might as well expect himself to improve his cultivation quickly.
…
"Brother, where is my Jade Phoenix Rabbit?"
Zheng Xuan ran over excitedly when she saw her brother Zheng Yuan returning home, and even hugged Zheng Yuan's arm and asked.
Too bad!
Zheng Yuan was dumbfounded when he faced his little sister. He was so busy talking about love with Chu Lin on the mountain that he really forgot about helping his sister catch a rabbit.
"Brother bad guy, people are angry and ignore you."
Zheng Xuan pouted and got angry, her brother didn't keep his promise at all.
"Huh? Candied haws on a stick, or five-color candied haws on a stick."
The next moment, Zheng Xuan's eyes lit up. Her brother was holding his favorite five-color candied haws in his hand.
"Thank you, brother."
Snap!
Zheng Xuan kissed Zheng Yuan on the face, and her face became full of smiles.
It turns out that Zheng Yuan thought of buying some food for his sister when he came back.
"You're such a shameless girl. How old are you going to get married in the future?"
Seeing her daughter's appearance, Zheng's mother couldn't help but blame her lovingly.
The key point is that Xuan'er is already a grown-up. How can a girl take the initiative to kiss another man?
"I know, mother."
Zheng Xuan hugged her mother's arm again and acted coquettishly.
She was still mumbling to herself, didn't she often sleep with her brother secretly when she was a child? She didn't want to get married. If she wanted to marry, she would marry her brother.
"Stop messing around, sister Xuan, mom, these are the clothes I bought for dad and you, little sister."
Zheng Yuan also knows that Zheng Xuan is not his biological sister, but he has long regarded her as his biological sister.
"Okay, okay."
Zheng's mother looked happy. Yuan'er had finally grown up. She only knew how to practice before, but now she can care about people.
"By the way, where is my dad?"
Before Zheng Yuan could finish his words, Father Zheng walked in from outside.
"The patriarch is looking for us to discuss the big competition in three days. This time, the eldest son of the Li family and the second son of the Zhao family are both strong enemies. I heard that the two families spent a lot of money to buy martial arts secret books for them, and also bought Yuan Zeng Dan. They are now at the third level of Kai Mai. Yuan'er, you have to be careful."
Although it is just a low-grade spiritual stone mine, it is related to cultivation resources.
Therefore, the other two major families spared no effort, and Zheng Yuan's father also had a silent look on his face. In the fight between dragons and tigers, there must be casualties.
In particular, the Zhao and Li families have joined forces, and the Wang family, an ally of the Zheng family, has also defected to these two families.
